------------------------------ MODULE W4Od1m1p5t1 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Controllers, Runways, None

VARIABLES holder, ring, committed, assignedBy, finalized, passes

vars == <<holder, ring, committed, assignedBy, finalized, passes>>

NextInRing(c) == ring[c]

Init ==
    /\ holder \in Controllers
    /\ ring \in [Controllers -> Controllers]
    /\ (\A c \in Controllers : ring[c] # c)
    /\ committed = {}
    /\ assignedBy = [w \in Runways |-> None]
    /\ finalized = {}
    /\ passes = {}

PostPass(c) ==
    /\ holder = c
    /\ passes' = passes \cup {[from |-> c, to |-> NextInRing(c)]}
    /\ holder' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ring, committed, assignedBy, finalized>>

DeliverPass(m) ==
    /\ m \in passes
    /\ holder = None
    /\ holder' = m.to
    /\ passes' = passes \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ring, committed, assignedBy, finalized>>

Commit(c, w) ==
    /\ holder = c
    /\ w \notin committed
    /\ committed' = committed \cup {w}
    /\ assignedBy' = [assignedBy EXCEPT ![w] = c]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, ring, finalized, passes>>

Finalize(c, w) ==
    /\ holder = c
    /\ w \in committed
    /\ assignedBy[w] = c
    /\ w \notin finalized
    /\ finalized' = finalized \cup {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, ring, committed, assignedBy, passes>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : PostPass(c)
    \/ \E m \in passes : DeliverPass(m)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, w \in Runways : Commit(c, w)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, w \in Runways : Finalize(c, w)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AssignmentSound ==
    /\ \A w \in Runways : (assignedBy[w] # None) <=> (w \in committed)
    /\ finalized \subseteq committed
    /\ \A w \in finalized : assignedBy[w] # None

================================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Controllers = {c1, c2, c3}
    Runways = {w1, w2}
    None = None
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AssignmentSound
nl: An air-traffic control center coordinates several controllers who share responsibility for a small set of runways, and only the controller currently holding a circulating token may act. The token is passed around a fixed ring: the holder posts a hand-off message naming the next controller in the ring and immediately gives up the token. Because the control network reorders traffic, posted hand-off messages sit in an in-flight pool and may be delivered in any order, and a message is delivered only when nobody currently holds the token. The holder may irreversibly commit a runway assignment for any not-yet-assigned runway, recording itself as the committer; once committed a runway stays committed forever. The controller that committed a runway may later finalize it, a second one-way step that files the assignment permanently. Both committing and finalizing a runway are one-way actions that can each happen at most once per runway. SAFETY PROPERTY: A runway records a committing controller exactly when it is committed, every finalized runway is also committed, and no finalized runway lacks a recorded committer, so assignments can never be filed out of order or duplicated.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m9p0t5 ----------------------------
\* Multiplayer lobby matchmaker: players compete for a single arena slot.
\* Reconfiguration bumps a monotone epoch; stale-epoch tokens are ignored.
\* A privileged admin may forcibly seize the slot for a player.
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Players, None

VARIABLES epoch, holder, grants, requests, adminSeized
vars == <<epoch, holder, grants, requests, adminSeized>>

MaxEpoch == 3

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ holder = None
    /\ grants = {}
    /\ requests = {}
    /\ adminSeized = FALSE

\* A player asks to join, tagging the request with the epoch it observed.
Request(p) ==
    /\ [player |-> p, epoch |-> epoch] \notin requests
    /\ requests' = requests \cup {[player |-> p, epoch |-> epoch]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, holder, grants, adminSeized>>

\* The slot must be free (no holder, no outstanding grant) to issue a token.
IssueGrant(r) ==
    /\ r \in requests
    /\ r.epoch = epoch
    /\ holder = None
    /\ grants = {}
    /\ grants' = {r}
    /\ requests' = requests \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, holder, adminSeized>>

\* The token bearer enters the slot, consuming its grant.
Claim(g) ==
    /\ g \in grants
    /\ g.epoch = epoch
    /\ holder' = g.player
    /\ grants' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, requests, adminSeized>>

\* The current holder leaves the slot.
Release ==
    /\ holder # None
    /\ holder' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, grants, requests, adminSeized>>

\* Reconfigure the lobby: raise the epoch and discard all in-flight state.
Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ holder' = None
    /\ grants' = {}
    /\ requests' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED adminSeized

\* Admin override: forcibly hand the slot to a player, evicting cleanly.
AdminOverride(p) ==
    /\ ~adminSeized
    /\ holder' = p
    /\ grants' = {}
    /\ adminSeized' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, requests>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players : Request(p)
    \/ \E r \in requests : IssueGrant(r)
    \/ \E g \in grants : Claim(g)
    \/ Release
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E p \in Players : AdminOverride(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Mutual exclusion: the slot never has both a seated holder and a live
\* grant token outstanding, so two players can never be admitted at once.
MutualExclusion == ~(holder # None /\ grants # {})
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Players = {p1, p2}
    None = None
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutualExclusion
nl: A matchmaker for a multiplayer game lobby hands out a single shared arena slot to competing players. Each player may submit a join request tagged with the epoch number it currently observes. When the slot is completely free (no seated holder and no outstanding grant), the matchmaker issues a grant token to one waiting request whose epoch is current. The player holding a valid grant token then claims the slot, becoming its holder, and later releases it when finished. To rebalance the lobby the coordinator can reconfigure, which raises the monotone epoch and discards every in-flight request and grant so that stale tokens are ignored. A privileged admin override can forcibly seize the slot for a chosen player, clearing any pending grant in the process. The whole point is that the slot behaves as a single critical resource. SAFETY PROPERTY: The arena slot never simultaneously has a seated holder and a live grant token outstanding, so two players can never occupy the critical resource at the same time.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od4m6p3t2 ----------------------------
\* Car-wash conveyor line. Two independent controllers draw from one pool of
\* wash bays, handing each car a time-limited lease before it rolls onto a bay.
\* Leases expire; an expired bay may be re-leased, but never while occupied.
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Controllers, Bays, Cars, None

VARIABLES clock, occupant, lease, requests, served
vars == <<clock, occupant, lease, requests, served>>

MaxClock == 2
LeaseLen == 2

\* A bay may be (re)leased when it holds no lease or its lease has expired.
Reusable(b) == IF lease[b] = None THEN TRUE ELSE lease[b].exp <= clock

\* A bay's lease is live (present and not yet expired).
Live(b) == lease[b] # None /\ lease[b].exp > clock

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ occupant = [b \in Bays |-> None]
    /\ lease = [b \in Bays |-> None]
    /\ requests = {}
    /\ served = {}

\* Either controller books a car for a bay by filing a request.
Submit(ctl, b, car) ==
    /\ [ctl |-> ctl, bay |-> b, car |-> car] \notin requests
    /\ requests' = requests \cup {[ctl |-> ctl, bay |-> b, car |-> car]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, occupant, lease, served>>

\* A lease is granted only when the bay is free or its old lease has expired,
\* and the physical bay is empty -- the guard against double allocation.
GrantLease(r) ==
    /\ r \in requests
    /\ occupant[r.bay] = None
    /\ Reusable(r.bay)
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![r.bay] =
                    [car |-> r.car, ctl |-> r.ctl, exp |-> clock + LeaseLen]]
    /\ requests' = requests \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, occupant, served>>

\* A car with a live lease rolls onto its bay.
Admit(b) ==
    /\ Live(b)
    /\ occupant[b] = None
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![b] = lease[b].car]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, lease, requests, served>>

\* Extend a live lease so a slow wash does not lapse mid-cycle.
Renew(b) ==
    /\ Live(b)
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![b].exp = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, occupant, requests, served>>

\* The car finishes, vacating the bay and clearing its lease.
Finish(b) ==
    /\ occupant[b] # None
    /\ served' = served \cup {occupant[b]}
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![b] = None]
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![b] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, requests>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, lease, requests, served>>

Next ==
    \/ \E ctl \in Controllers, b \in Bays, car \in Cars : Submit(ctl, b, car)
    \/ \E r \in requests : GrantLease(r)
    \/ \E b \in Bays : Admit(b)
    \/ \E b \in Bays : Renew(b)
    \/ \E b \in Bays : Finish(b)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ClockBound == clock <= MaxClock

\* No double allocation: any physically occupied bay is backed by exactly the
\* car named in that bay's current lease, so no second car can share the bay.
NoDoubleAllocation ==
    \A b \in Bays : occupant[b] # None =>
        (lease[b] # None /\ lease[b].car = occupant[b])
=============================================================================
nl: A car-wash conveyor line runs several wash bays that are shared by two independent controllers drawing from one common pool. Either controller can file a request to book a particular car onto a particular bay. A controller grants a lease for a bay only when that bay is physically empty and its previous lease is absent or already expired, which is the guard that stops the two controllers from double-booking. Once a car holds a live lease it rolls onto its bay and becomes the occupant. A lease can be renewed while still live so a slow wash does not lapse in the middle of a cycle. When the car finishes it vacates the bay and its lease is cleared, and the car is recorded as served. A shared clock advances in bounded ticks, and expiry is measured against it. The design ensures a bay is never allocated to two cars at once. SAFETY PROPERTY: Every physically occupied bay is backed by exactly the car named in that bay's current lease, so the same slot is never allocated to two different cars simultaneously.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m1p5t0 ----------------------------
\* Subway signalling block system. Signal boxes sit on a token ring; only the
\* box holding the token may act on the track. Committing a block to a train
\* (routing it in) is irreversible and must happen at most once per block.
\* A signal box may silently drop offline and later come back.
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Boxes, Blocks, None

VARIABLES holder, armed, fired, owner, crashed
vars == <<holder, armed, fired, owner, crashed>>

Init ==
    /\ holder \in Boxes
    /\ armed = [b \in Blocks |-> FALSE]
    /\ fired = [b \in Blocks |-> FALSE]
    /\ owner = [b \in Blocks |-> None]
    /\ crashed = {}

\* The token holder clears (arms) a still-unrouted block, readying it.
Arm(b) ==
    /\ holder \notin crashed
    /\ ~fired[b]
    /\ ~armed[b]
    /\ armed' = [armed EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, fired, owner, crashed>>

\* Irreversible commit: route a train into an armed block. Latches forever and
\* records the committing box; the block is disarmed and can never re-arm.
Commit(b) ==
    /\ holder \notin crashed
    /\ armed[b]
    /\ ~fired[b]
    /\ fired' = [fired EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE]
    /\ armed' = [armed EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![b] = holder]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, crashed>>

\* Pass the token round the ring to another live box.
PassToken ==
    /\ holder \notin crashed
    /\ \E q \in Boxes : q # holder /\ holder' = q
    /\ UNCHANGED <<armed, fired, owner, crashed>>

\* A box silently crashes.
Crash(p) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, armed, fired, owner>>

\* A crashed box recovers and rejoins the ring.
Recover(p) ==
    /\ p \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, armed, fired, owner>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : Arm(b)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : Commit(b)
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E p \in Boxes : Crash(p)
    \/ \E p \in Boxes : Recover(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* At-most-once: the irreversible commit is a latch tied to a recorded owner,
\* and a committed block can never be re-armed, so it can commit only once.
AtMostOnceCommit ==
    \A b \in Blocks :
        /\ (fired[b] <=> owner[b] # None)
        /\ (fired[b] => ~armed[b])
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Boxes = {s1, s2}
    Blocks = {blk1, blk2}
    None = None
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AtMostOnceCommit
nl: A subway signalling block system coordinates several signal boxes arranged on a token ring. Only the box currently holding the token is permitted to act on the track, which gives it exclusive access. The holder may arm a still-unrouted track block, clearing it and readying it for a train. The holder may then commit an armed block by routing a train into it; this commit is irreversible, latches permanently, and records which box performed it. Once committed, a block is disarmed and can never be armed again. The token is passed around the ring from the holder to another live box. Any signal box may silently crash and drop offline, and a crashed box may later recover and rejoin the ring. The central guarantee is that routing a train into a block is a one-shot action. SAFETY PROPERTY: For every track block the irreversible commit is a latch bound to a single recorded owner and can never be re-armed, so a train is routed into any given block at most once.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od8m8p1t2 ----------------------------
\* University course-registration system. Two independent registrar instances
\* share one pool of course records. To update a record a registrar must take
\* the coarse catalog lock first, then the fine per-course lock (hierarchical),
\* read the current version, and only then commit -- so no update is lost.
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Registrars, Records, None

VARIABLES coarseLock, fineLock, version, rsnap, committers
vars == <<coarseLock, fineLock, version, rsnap, committers>>

MaxVer == 4

Init ==
    /\ coarseLock = None
    /\ fineLock = [r \in Records |-> None]
    /\ version = 0
    /\ rsnap = [g \in Registrars |-> None]
    /\ committers = {}

\* Take the coarse catalog lock (only one registrar may hold it).
AcquireCoarse(g) ==
    /\ coarseLock = None
    /\ coarseLock' = g
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fineLock, version, rsnap, committers>>

\* With the coarse lock held, take a fine per-course lock and snapshot version.
AcquireFine(g, r) ==
    /\ coarseLock = g
    /\ fineLock[r] = None
    /\ \A rr \in Records : fineLock[rr] # g
    /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![r] = g]
    /\ rsnap' = [rsnap EXCEPT ![g] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, version, committers>>

\* Commit the read-modify-write, bumping the version and releasing both locks.
Commit(g, r) ==
    /\ fineLock[r] = g
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![r] = None]
    /\ coarseLock' = None
    /\ rsnap' = [rsnap EXCEPT ![g] = None]
    /\ committers' = committers \cup {g}

\* Abort a fine lock without writing.
ReleaseFine(g, r) ==
    /\ fineLock[r] = g
    /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![r] = None]
    /\ rsnap' = [rsnap EXCEPT ![g] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, version, committers>>

\* Drop the coarse lock (holding no fine locks).
ReleaseCoarse(g) ==
    /\ coarseLock = g
    /\ \A r \in Records : fineLock[r] # g
    /\ coarseLock' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fineLock, version, rsnap, committers>>

Next ==
    \/ \E g \in Registrars : AcquireCoarse(g)
    \/ \E g \in Registrars, r \in Records : AcquireFine(g, r)
    \/ \E g \in Registrars, r \in Records : Commit(g, r)
    \/ \E g \in Registrars, r \in Records : ReleaseFine(g, r)
    \/ \E g \in Registrars : ReleaseCoarse(g)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

VersionBound == version <= MaxVer

\* No lost updates: any registrar holding a fine lock (in its write section)
\* read the version that is still current, because the coarse lock it also
\* holds blocks every other commit -- so its write is never based on stale data.
NoLostUpdate ==
    \A g \in Registrars, r \in Records :
        fineLock[r] = g => rsnap[g] = version
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Registrars = {g1, g2}
    Records = {cs101, cs102}
    None = None
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
CONSTRAINT VersionBound
nl: A university course-registration system lets two independent registrar instances update a shared pool of course records. Because both instances touch the same pool, updates are protected by a two-level hierarchical lock. A registrar must first acquire the coarse catalog lock, of which only one may be held at a time. Holding the coarse lock, it then acquires a fine per-course lock on the record it wants and snapshots that record's current version. To finish it commits a read-modify-write that bumps the version and releases both locks together, recording itself as a committer. A registrar may instead abort by releasing the fine lock, and it drops the coarse lock once it holds no fine locks. Because the coarse lock serializes all commits, a registrar's snapshot stays current from read to write. SAFETY PROPERTY: Any registrar holding a fine lock read the version that is still current, so its committed update is never based on stale data and no update is ever lost.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od15m1p2t4 ----------------------------
\* Stock exchange opening auction. Traders sit on a token ring; only the token
\* holder may act on the order book. Shares flow through three stages -- a
\* trader's own holdings, resting orders in the book, and a crossed pool
\* awaiting settlement -- and no share is ever created or destroyed. The book's
\* resting capacity can be raised or lowered at runtime.
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Traders, TotalShares, MaxCap

VARIABLES holder, holdings, book, crossed, capacity
vars == <<holder, holdings, book, crossed, capacity>>

\* Total shares currently held by all traders.
SumHoldings ==
    LET rec[S \in SUBSET Traders] ==
        IF S = {} THEN 0
        ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE
             IN holdings[x] + rec[S \ {x}]
    IN rec[Traders]

Init ==
    /\ holder \in Traders
    /\ holdings \in [Traders -> 0..TotalShares]
    /\ SumHoldings = TotalShares
    /\ book = 0
    /\ crossed = 0
    /\ capacity = 2

\* The token holder rests one of its shares as an order (bounded by capacity).
Submit(t) ==
    /\ holder = t
    /\ holdings[t] >= 1
    /\ book < capacity
    /\ holdings' = [holdings EXCEPT ![t] = @ - 1]
    /\ book' = book + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, crossed, capacity>>

\* The auction crosses one resting share into the pending-settlement pool.
Cross(t) ==
    /\ holder = t
    /\ book >= 1
    /\ book' = book - 1
    /\ crossed' = crossed + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, holdings, capacity>>

\* A crossed share settles back into the token holder's holdings.
Settle(t) ==
    /\ holder = t
    /\ crossed >= 1
    /\ crossed' = crossed - 1
    /\ holdings' = [holdings EXCEPT ![t] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, book, capacity>>

\* Pass the token round the ring to another trader.
PassToken ==
    /\ \E q \in Traders : q # holder /\ holder' = q
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holdings, book, crossed, capacity>>

\* Raise the resting capacity of the book.
RaiseCap ==
    /\ capacity < MaxCap
    /\ capacity' = capacity + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, holdings, book, crossed>>

\* Lower the resting capacity, but never below what is already resting.
LowerCap ==
    /\ capacity > book
    /\ capacity' = capacity - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, holdings, book, crossed>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Traders : Submit(t)
    \/ \E t \in Traders : Cross(t)
    \/ \E t \in Traders : Settle(t)
    \/ PassToken
    \/ RaiseCap
    \/ LowerCap

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapBound == capacity <= MaxCap

\* Conservation: the shares scattered across holdings, resting orders, and the
\* crossed pool always sum to exactly the starting total -- nothing is created
\* or destroyed as shares flow through the auction.
SharesConserved == SumHoldings + book + crossed = TotalShares
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Traders = {t1, t2}
    TotalShares = 3
    MaxCap = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SharesConserved
CONSTRAINT CapBound
nl: A stock exchange opening auction matches shares among traders arranged on a token ring. Only the trader currently holding the token may act on the shared order book, which gives it exclusive access. Shares move through three stages: a trader's own holdings, resting orders sitting in the book, and a crossed pool of matched shares awaiting settlement. The token holder can submit one of its own shares as a resting order, provided the book has not reached its capacity. The auction crosses a resting share into the pending-settlement pool, and a crossed share later settles back into the token holder's holdings. The token is passed around the ring to another trader. The book's resting capacity can be raised at runtime up to a maximum, or lowered, but never below the number of shares already resting. Throughout, the shares merely change stage rather than appearing or vanishing. SAFETY PROPERTY: The shares spread across traders' holdings, resting orders, and the crossed pool always sum to exactly the starting total, so no share is ever created or destroyed.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od6m8p0t5 ----------------------------
\* Elevator bank in a skyscraper. A car may enter a hoistway shaft only by
\* taking the coarse dispatcher lock first and then a fine per-shaft lock
\* (hierarchical). A shaft is a critical resource: at most one car inside.
\* A privileged maintenance admin may override and seize a shaft.
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cars, Shafts, Admin, None

Agents == Cars \cup {Admin}

VARIABLES coarseLock, fineLock, occupant, adminUsed, pending
vars == <<coarseLock, fineLock, occupant, adminUsed, pending>>

Init ==
    /\ coarseLock = None
    /\ fineLock = [s \in Shafts |-> None]
    /\ occupant = [s \in Shafts |-> None]
    /\ adminUsed = FALSE
    /\ pending = {}

\* A car signals that it wants to move.
Request(c) ==
    /\ c \notin pending
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, fineLock, occupant, adminUsed>>

\* Take the coarse dispatcher lock (only one car may hold it).
AcquireCoarse(c) ==
    /\ c \in pending
    /\ coarseLock = None
    /\ coarseLock' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fineLock, occupant, adminUsed, pending>>

\* Holding the coarse lock, take a free shaft's fine lock and enter it, then
\* drop the coarse lock. The shaft must be empty and unlocked to enter.
Enter(c, s) ==
    /\ coarseLock = c
    /\ fineLock[s] = None
    /\ occupant[s] = None
    /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![s] = c]
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![s] = c]
    /\ coarseLock' = None
    /\ pending' = pending \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED adminUsed

\* Give up the coarse lock without entering (e.g. no shaft available).
AbortCoarse(c) ==
    /\ coarseLock = c
    /\ coarseLock' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fineLock, occupant, adminUsed, pending>>

\* A car leaves its shaft, releasing the fine lock.
Exit(c, s) ==
    /\ occupant[s] = c
    /\ c \in Cars
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![s] = None]
    /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![s] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, adminUsed, pending>>

\* Admin override: forcibly seize a shaft for maintenance, evicting any car.
AdminOverride(s) ==
    /\ ~adminUsed
    /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![s] = Admin]
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![s] = Admin]
    /\ adminUsed' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, pending>>

\* Admin releases a shaft it seized.
AdminRelease(s) ==
    /\ occupant[s] = Admin
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![s] = None]
    /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![s] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, adminUsed, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Request(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : AcquireCoarse(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars, s \in Shafts : Enter(c, s)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : AbortCoarse(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars, s \in Shafts : Exit(c, s)
    \/ \E s \in Shafts : AdminOverride(s)
    \/ \E s \in Shafts : AdminRelease(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Mutual exclusion: whatever agent physically occupies a shaft is exactly the
\* agent holding that shaft's fine lock, and a fine lock has one owner, so no
\* two cars can ever be inside the same shaft at once.
MutualExclusion ==
    \A s \in Shafts : occupant[s] # None => fineLock[s] = occupant[s]
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cars = {c1, c2}
    Shafts = {sh1, sh2}
    Admin = Admin
    None = None
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutualExclusion
nl: An elevator bank in a skyscraper coordinates several cars that share a set of hoistway shafts. Each shaft is a critical resource that at most one car may be inside at a time. A car that wants to move first files a request, then acquires the coarse dispatcher lock, of which only one car may be held at once. Holding the coarse lock, the car takes the fine lock on an empty, unlocked shaft, enters it, and immediately drops the coarse lock, keeping only the fine lock. If no shaft is available the car may abort and give up the coarse lock without entering. A car later exits its shaft, releasing the fine lock. A privileged maintenance admin may override the discipline to forcibly seize a shaft, evicting whatever car is inside, and later release it. SAFETY PROPERTY: Whatever agent physically occupies a shaft is exactly the agent holding that shaft's single-owner fine lock, so no two cars are ever inside the same shaft at once.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od4m0p2t0 ----------------------------
(* A car-wash conveyor line. Cars enter at the head, pass through the wash    *)
(* stage, and exit. Worker processes advance cars between stages using an     *)
(* optimistic version stamp: a worker reads the conveyor version, stages a    *)
(* move, and only commits when the version is still unchanged (else it        *)
(* retries). A worker may crash silently at any time. No car is ever created  *)
(* or destroyed by any of these transitions.                                  *)
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS TOTAL, Workers

VARIABLES entryQ, washing, done, ver, staged, crashed
\* entryQ: cars waiting to enter ; washing: cars in the wash ; done: exited
\* ver: conveyor version stamp ; staged: per-worker staged move ; crashed: dead

vars == <<entryQ, washing, done, ver, staged, crashed>>

IdleMove == [kind |-> "idle", rver |-> 0]
Kinds == {"in", "out"}   \* "in": entryQ->washing ; "out": washing->done

TypeInv ==
    /\ entryQ \in 0..TOTAL
    /\ washing \in 0..TOTAL
    /\ done \in 0..TOTAL
    /\ ver \in Nat
    /\ crashed \subseteq Workers

Init ==
    /\ entryQ = TOTAL
    /\ washing = 0
    /\ done = 0
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ staged = [w \in Workers |-> IdleMove]
    /\ crashed = {}

\* A live worker reads the version and stages a move for a stage that has a car.
StageMove(w, k) ==
    /\ w \notin crashed
    /\ staged[w].kind = "idle"
    /\ k \in Kinds
    /\ (k = "in") => entryQ > 0
    /\ (k = "out") => washing > 0
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![w] = [kind |-> k, rver |-> ver]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<entryQ, washing, done, ver, crashed>>

\* Commit succeeds only if the version has not moved since the read.
Commit(w) ==
    /\ w \notin crashed
    /\ staged[w].kind # "idle"
    /\ staged[w].rver = ver
    /\ LET k == staged[w].kind IN
         /\ (k = "in") =>
              /\ entryQ > 0
              /\ entryQ' = entryQ - 1
              /\ washing' = washing + 1
              /\ done' = done
         /\ (k = "out") =>
              /\ washing > 0
              /\ washing' = washing - 1
              /\ done' = done + 1
              /\ entryQ' = entryQ
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![w] = IdleMove]
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

\* A stale staged move (version changed underneath) is abandoned and re-read.
Retry(w) ==
    /\ w \notin crashed
    /\ staged[w].kind # "idle"
    /\ staged[w].rver # ver
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![w] = IdleMove]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<entryQ, washing, done, ver, crashed>>

\* A worker crashes silently, dropping whatever it had staged.
Crash(w) ==
    /\ w \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {w}
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![w] = IdleMove]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<entryQ, washing, done, ver>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Workers, k \in Kinds : StageMove(w, k)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Commit(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Retry(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Crash(w)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: every car is accounted for in exactly one stage; the fleet is
\* neither grown nor shrunk by staging, committing, retrying, or crashing.
Conserved == entryQ + washing + done = TOTAL
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    TOTAL = 2
    Workers = {w1, w2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conserved
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line moves cars through three stages: a waiting entry queue, the wash stage, and the exit. Two worker processes advance cars from one stage to the next. Before moving a car, a worker reads the conveyor's version stamp and stages the move it intends to perform. The worker commits the move only if the version stamp is still the value it read; committing advances one car and bumps the version. If another worker has advanced the conveyor in the meantime, the version no longer matches and the staged move is abandoned and retried. Any worker may crash silently at any moment, discarding whatever move it had staged and taking no further steps. Cars are never duplicated and never vanish; a car that leaves one stage always arrives at the next. The total number of cars on the line stays fixed for the life of the system.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of cars in the entry queue, in the wash, and exited always sums to the fixed fleet total, so no car is ever created or destroyed.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od17m0p4t1 ----------------------------
(* An airport baggage router. Bags are routed onto carousels. A routing       *)
(* request is an in-flight message carrying the carousel version the router    *)
(* observed; because the network reorders freely, the set of in-flight        *)
(* messages may be committed in any order. A commit lands a bag only if the    *)
(* carousel version is still the one the request read AND the carousel has     *)
(* spare room; otherwise the request is rejected and must be resubmitted. Bags *)
(* also leave carousels, freeing room. No carousel ever holds more bags than   *)
(* its capacity.                                                               *)
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Bags, Carousels, CAP

VARIABLES inflight, load, ver, placed

vars == <<inflight, load, ver, placed>>
\* inflight: set of routing messages ; load: bags per carousel
\* ver: per-carousel version stamp ; placed: carousel each bag rests on

NONE == "unplaced"

HasMsg(b) == \E m \in inflight : m.bag = b

Init ==
    /\ inflight = {}
    /\ load = [c \in Carousels |-> 0]
    /\ ver = [c \in Carousels |-> 0]
    /\ placed = [b \in Bags |-> NONE]

\* Router observes the carousel version and emits a routing request for bag b.
Submit(b, c) ==
    /\ placed[b] = NONE
    /\ ~HasMsg(b)
    /\ inflight' = inflight \cup {[bag |-> b, dest |-> c, rver |-> ver[c]]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, ver, placed>>

\* Any in-flight request may commit next (reordering): succeeds only if the
\* version is unchanged and the carousel is below capacity.
Commit(m) ==
    /\ m \in inflight
    /\ m.rver = ver[m.dest]
    /\ load[m.dest] < CAP
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![m.dest] = @ + 1]
    /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![m.dest] = @ + 1]
    /\ placed' = [placed EXCEPT ![m.bag] = m.dest]
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}

\* A stale or over-capacity request is dropped; the bag may be resubmitted.
Reject(m) ==
    /\ m \in inflight
    /\ (m.rver # ver[m.dest] \/ load[m.dest] = CAP)
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, ver, placed>>

\* A bag leaves its carousel, freeing a slot and advancing the version.
Depart(b) ==
    /\ placed[b] # NONE
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![placed[b]] = @ - 1]
    /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![placed[b]] = @ + 1]
    /\ placed' = [placed EXCEPT ![b] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED inflight

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Bags, c \in Carousels : Submit(b, c)
    \/ \E m \in inflight : Commit(m)
    \/ \E m \in inflight : Reject(m)
    \/ \E b \in Bags : Depart(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

VerBound == \A c \in Carousels : ver[c] <= 4

\* Bounded capacity: no carousel is ever loaded beyond its physical capacity,
\* however requests are reordered or retried.
WithinCapacity == \A c \in Carousels : load[c] <= CAP
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Bags = {b1, b2}
    Carousels = {k1, k2}
    CAP = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT WithinCapacity
CONSTRAINT VerBound
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
An airport baggage router sends bags onto a set of carousels, each with a fixed capacity. To route a bag, the router reads the destination carousel's version stamp and emits an in-flight routing request carrying that stamp. Because the delivery network reorders traffic freely, the in-flight requests may be committed in any order. A request commits successfully only if the carousel's version stamp still equals the value the request read and the carousel currently has room; committing places the bag, increments the load, and bumps the version. A request that arrives stale, or that finds the carousel full, is rejected, and the bag may be resubmitted later. Bags also depart from carousels, which frees a slot and advances that carousel's version. Through any interleaving of routing, committing, rejecting, and departing, a carousel never holds more bags than its capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every carousel's load stays at or below its fixed capacity no matter how routing requests are reordered or retried.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m0p3t1 ----------------------------
(* A library book reservation system. Patrons reserve individual copy slots.   *)
(* A reservation request records the slot version the patron observed and      *)
(* travels the network, which may reorder requests arbitrarily. A request      *)
(* commits only if the slot is still free at the version the patron read;      *)
(* committing links the patron to the slot and bumps the slot version, so a    *)
(* concurrent request for the same slot becomes stale and must retry. Patrons  *)
(* later return their copies. The system never links one slot to two patrons.  *)
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Patrons, Slots

VARIABLES inflight, owner, held, ver

vars == <<inflight, owner, held, ver>>
\* inflight: set of reservation messages ; owner: patron holding each slot
\* held: slot each patron holds ; ver: per-slot version stamp

NONE == "free"

HasReq(p) == \E m \in inflight : m.pat = p

Init ==
    /\ inflight = {}
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ held = [p \in Patrons |-> NONE]
    /\ ver = [s \in Slots |-> 0]

\* Patron reads the slot version and sends a reservation request.
Request(p, s) ==
    /\ held[p] = NONE
    /\ ~HasReq(p)
    /\ inflight' = inflight \cup {[pat |-> p, slot |-> s, rver |-> ver[s]]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, held, ver>>

\* Any pending request may commit next (reordering): allowed only if the slot
\* is still free at the observed version.
Commit(m) ==
    /\ m \in inflight
    /\ owner[m.slot] = NONE
    /\ ver[m.slot] = m.rver
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![m.slot] = m.pat]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![m.pat] = m.slot]
    /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![m.slot] = @ + 1]
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}

\* A request that finds the slot taken or the version advanced is retried.
Retry(m) ==
    /\ m \in inflight
    /\ (owner[m.slot] # NONE \/ ver[m.slot] # m.rver)
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, held, ver>>

\* A patron returns a copy, freeing the slot and advancing its version.
Release(p) ==
    /\ held[p] # NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![held[p]] = NONE]
    /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![held[p]] = @ + 1]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![p] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED inflight

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, s \in Slots : Request(p, s)
    \/ \E m \in inflight : Commit(m)
    \/ \E m \in inflight : Retry(m)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Release(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

VerBound == \A s \in Slots : ver[s] <= 4

\* No double allocation: a slot and the patron said to hold it agree, and every
\* held slot points back to its holder -- so no two patrons ever hold one slot.
NoDoubleAlloc ==
    /\ \A s \in Slots : owner[s] # NONE => held[owner[s]] = s
    /\ \A p \in Patrons : held[p] # NONE => owner[held[p]] = p
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Patrons = {p1, p2}
    Slots = {s1, s2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
CONSTRAINT VerBound
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A library book reservation system lets patrons reserve individual copy slots of a title. When a patron wants a slot, the system reads that slot's version stamp and sends a reservation request carrying the stamp across a network that may reorder requests arbitrarily. A pending request commits only if the slot is still free and its version stamp equals the value the request read; committing links the patron to that slot and bumps the slot's version. Because the version advanced, any other request that read the same slot earlier is now stale and is retried instead of committed. A request that finds the slot already taken is likewise retried. Patrons eventually return their copies, which frees the slot and advances its version again. However requests are reordered or retried, the system never links a single slot to two different patrons at the same time.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No slot is ever allocated to two patrons at once; each slot and its holder always agree on the reservation.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m8p5t4 ----------------------------
(* A subway signalling block system. Trains take a coarse line lock before     *)
(* any fine block lock (hierarchical locking). Only while holding both locks   *)
(* may a train seal a block -- an irreversible dispatch that can occur at most  *)
(* once per block, since a sealed block is never reopened. Blocks may be taken  *)
(* out of service or restored while idle, so the usable capacity of the line   *)
(* changes at runtime. Locks are released together when a train is done.        *)
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Trains, Blocks

VARIABLES coarse, flock, phase, sealer, inService

vars == <<coarse, flock, phase, sealer, inService>>
\* coarse: holder of the line lock ; flock: fine lock holder per block
\* phase: open/sealed per block ; sealer: train that sealed a block
\* inService: blocks currently in service (runtime capacity)

NOBODY == "none"

Init ==
    /\ coarse = NOBODY
    /\ flock = [b \in Blocks |-> NOBODY]
    /\ phase = [b \in Blocks |-> "open"]
    /\ sealer = [b \in Blocks |-> NOBODY]
    /\ inService = Blocks

\* Coarse (line) lock must be taken first.
AcquireCoarse(t) ==
    /\ coarse = NOBODY
    /\ coarse' = t
    /\ UNCHANGED <<flock, phase, sealer, inService>>

\* Fine (block) lock only while already holding the coarse lock; block in service.
AcquireFine(t, b) ==
    /\ coarse = t
    /\ b \in inService
    /\ flock[b] = NOBODY
    /\ flock' = [flock EXCEPT ![b] = t]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, phase, sealer, inService>>

\* Irreversible dispatch: seals an open block, recording the sealing train.
Dispatch(t, b) ==
    /\ coarse = t
    /\ flock[b] = t
    /\ phase[b] = "open"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![b] = "sealed"]
    /\ sealer' = [sealer EXCEPT ![b] = t]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, flock, inService>>

\* Releasing the coarse lock also drops every fine lock the train held.
Release(t) ==
    /\ coarse = t
    /\ coarse' = NOBODY
    /\ flock' = [b \in Blocks |-> IF flock[b] = t THEN NOBODY ELSE flock[b]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, sealer, inService>>

\* Runtime capacity change: an idle block is taken out of or put back in service.
Recapacity(b) ==
    /\ flock[b] = NOBODY
    /\ inService' = IF b \in inService THEN inService \ {b} ELSE inService \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, flock, phase, sealer>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Trains : AcquireCoarse(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : AcquireFine(t, b)
    \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : Dispatch(t, b)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Release(t)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : Recapacity(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Irreversible-at-most-once: a block is marked sealed exactly when a sealing
\* train is on record for it, and no transition ever reopens a sealed block --
\* so the seal happens at most once per block.
SealOnce == \A b \in Blocks : (phase[b] = "sealed") <=> (sealer[b] # NOBODY)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Trains = {t1, t2}
    Blocks = {b1, b2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SealOnce
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A subway signalling block system controls how trains occupy track segments called blocks. A train must first take the coarse line lock, and only while holding it may it take the fine lock on a specific block, so locks are always acquired coarse before fine. Holding both locks, a train may seal a block: an irreversible dispatch that records the sealing train and can never be undone. Because a sealed block is never reopened, sealing can occur at most once per block. Blocks that are idle can be pulled out of service or restored, so the line's usable capacity changes while the system runs. When a train finishes, releasing the coarse lock also drops every fine lock it held. The correspondence between a block being sealed and having a recorded sealer is always exact.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The irreversible sealing of a block happens at most once, reflected by each block being marked sealed exactly when it has a recorded sealing train.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m5p6t4 ----------------------------
(* A warehouse robot fleet governs each fleet action by quorum vote. Robots    *)
(* cast votes stamped with the current configuration epoch. An action commits  *)
(* only when the current-epoch votes from active members form a strict         *)
(* majority of the members; votes from a stale epoch or from non-members are   *)
(* ignored. The fleet is reconfigured at runtime -- robots join or leave, which *)
(* changes the capacity and bumps the epoch, making outstanding votes stale.   *)
(* A committed action is authorized only by a current-member majority.         *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Robots

VARIABLES epoch, members, votes, phase, authBy

vars == <<epoch, members, votes, phase, authBy>>
\* epoch: configuration epoch ; members: active robots (capacity)
\* votes: cast votes [voter, ep] ; phase: voting/done ; authBy: committing quorum

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ members = Robots
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ authBy = {}

CurrentQuorum ==
    { v.voter : v \in { w \in votes : w.ep = epoch /\ w.voter \in members } }

\* Runtime reconfiguration: a robot joins or leaves, bumping the epoch so any
\* outstanding votes become stale. A completed action's authority resets.
Reconfigure(r) ==
    /\ \/ (r \in members /\ Cardinality(members) > 1 /\ members' = members \ {r})
       \/ (r \notin members /\ members' = members \cup {r})
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ authBy' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED votes

\* An active member casts a current-epoch vote for the pending action.
Vote(r) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ r \in members
    /\ [voter |-> r, ep |-> epoch] \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {[voter |-> r, ep |-> epoch]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, members, phase, authBy>>

\* Commit only on a strict majority of current members voting this epoch.
Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ 2 * Cardinality(CurrentQuorum) > Cardinality(members)
    /\ authBy' = CurrentQuorum
    /\ phase' = "done"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, members, votes>>

\* Begin a fresh action: clear votes and reset the phase.
Reset ==
    /\ phase = "done"
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ authBy' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, members>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Reconfigure(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Vote(r)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

EpochBound == epoch <= 3

\* No unauthorized or stale actor: whenever an action stands committed, its
\* authorizers are all current members and form a strict majority of them.
QuorumSound ==
    (phase = "done") =>
        /\ authBy \subseteq members
        /\ 2 * Cardinality(authBy) > Cardinality(members)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Robots = {r1, r2, r3}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT QuorumSound
CONSTRAINT EpochBound
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet decides each fleet action by quorum vote. Every robot that votes stamps its vote with the current configuration epoch. An action is committed only when the votes cast in the current epoch by active members form a strict majority of the members; any vote from a stale epoch or from a robot that is not a current member is ignored. The fleet can be reconfigured while running: a robot joins or leaves, which changes the fleet's capacity and bumps the epoch, so votes gathered before the change become stale. Reconfiguration also resets any action that had been decided. When a fresh action begins, the outstanding votes are cleared. A committed action therefore reflects only the authorization of a majority of the robots that are currently members. No stale or unauthorized robot can push an action through.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any committed action is authorized only by current members forming a strict majority, never by a stale-epoch or non-member robot.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od15m7p1t1 ----------------------------
(* A stock exchange opening auction maintains one shared record: the set of    *)
(* orders accepted into the opening book. Each accepted order is written with   *)
(* a compare-and-swap: the writer snapshots the book and its version, then      *)
(* commits its snapshot-plus-order only if the book still equals that snapshot  *)
(* at that version. The auction clock ticks independently and the network       *)
(* reorders in-flight writes, so a snapshot may go stale before it commits; a   *)
(* stale write is rejected and retried rather than clobbering the book. No      *)
(* acknowledged order is ever lost from the shared record.                      *)
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Orders

VARIABLES book, ver, inflight, acked

vars == <<book, ver, inflight, acked>>
\* book: the shared opening-auction record ; ver: compare-and-swap version
\* inflight: set of pending CAS writes ; acked: orders acknowledged accepted

HasWrite(o) == \E m \in inflight : m.ord = o

Init ==
    /\ book = {}
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ inflight = {}
    /\ acked = {}

\* Snapshot the shared record and version, then emit a CAS write for order o.
Submit(o) ==
    /\ o \notin acked
    /\ ~HasWrite(o)
    /\ inflight' = inflight \cup {[ord |-> o, snap |-> book, sver |-> ver]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<book, ver, acked>>

\* Compare-and-swap: any pending write may commit next (reordering), but only
\* if the book and version still match the snapshot it was built from.
Commit(m) ==
    /\ m \in inflight
    /\ book = m.snap
    /\ ver = m.sver
    /\ book' = m.snap \cup {m.ord}
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {m.ord}
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}

\* A write whose snapshot or version is stale is rejected and retried.
Retry(m) ==
    /\ m \in inflight
    /\ (book # m.snap \/ ver # m.sver)
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<book, ver, acked>>

\* The auction clock advances, bumping the version and staling open snapshots.
Tick ==
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<book, inflight, acked>>

Next ==
    \/ \E o \in Orders : Submit(o)
    \/ \E m \in inflight : Commit(m)
    \/ \E m \in inflight : Retry(m)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

VerBound == ver <= 5

\* No lost updates: every order the auction has acknowledged accepting is still
\* present in the shared book -- a stale compare-and-swap never clobbers it.
NoLostUpdate == acked \subseteq book
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Orders = {o1, o2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
CONSTRAINT VerBound
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A stock exchange opening auction keeps one shared record: the book of orders accepted for the opening cross. To accept an order, a writer takes a snapshot of the current book together with its version number and then issues a compare-and-swap write built from that snapshot plus the new order. The write commits only if the book and version still equal the snapshot the writer read; committing installs the new book and advances the version. The auction clock ticks on its own and the network reorders in-flight writes, so a writer's snapshot can become stale before its write is processed. A stale write is rejected and retried rather than being allowed to overwrite the book with an out-of-date value. Because commits are gated by the compare-and-swap, no order that has already been acknowledged into the book is ever silently dropped by a later write. Every acknowledged order remains in the shared record.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every order the auction has acknowledged accepting stays present in the shared book, so no update is ever lost to a stale compare-and-swap.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od0m9p6t2 --------------------------
\* Hospital operating-room scheduler. Two independent coordinators share one
\* pool of operating rooms. Room bookings are governed by a monotone epoch:
\* whenever the theatre is reconfigured the epoch advances, and only a
\* coordinator that has synchronised to the current epoch may book or free a
\* room. A coordinator running on a stale epoch is not authorised to act.
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Coords, Rooms, MaxEpoch, None

\* epoch: current global reconfiguration epoch; local[c]: epoch c last synced;
\* owner[r]: coordinator holding room r or None; bookEpoch[r]: booking epoch.
VARIABLES epoch, local, owner, bookEpoch

vars == <<epoch, local, owner, bookEpoch>>

Authorized(c) == local[c] = epoch

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ local \in [Coords -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ owner \in [Rooms -> Coords \cup {None}]
    /\ bookEpoch \in [Rooms -> 0..MaxEpoch]

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 1
    /\ local = [c \in Coords |-> 1]
    /\ owner = [r \in Rooms |-> None]
    /\ bookEpoch = [r \in Rooms |-> 0]

\* Reconfigure the theatre: bump the global epoch and adopt it locally.
Reconfigure(c) ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ local' = [local EXCEPT ![c] = epoch + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, bookEpoch>>

\* A lagging coordinator catches up to the current epoch.
Sync(c) ==
    /\ local[c] < epoch
    /\ local' = [local EXCEPT ![c] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, owner, bookEpoch>>

\* Only an authorised (current-epoch) coordinator may book a free room.
Book(c, r) ==
    /\ Authorized(c)
    /\ owner[r] = None
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![r] = c]
    /\ bookEpoch' = [bookEpoch EXCEPT ![r] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, local>>

\* An authorised coordinator releases a room it holds.
Release(c, r) ==
    /\ Authorized(c)
    /\ owner[r] = c
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![r] = None]
    /\ bookEpoch' = [bookEpoch EXCEPT ![r] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, local>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Coords : Reconfigure(c)
    \/ \E c \in Coords : Sync(c)
    \/ \E c \in Coords, r \in Rooms : Book(c, r)
    \/ \E c \in Coords, r \in Rooms : Release(c, r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No booking ever carries an epoch beyond the global epoch: a booked room's
\* recorded epoch is bounded by the current epoch and is positive, so no stale
\* or future (unauthorised) participant could have written it.
NoStaleBooking ==
    \A r \in Rooms :
        owner[r] # None => (bookEpoch[r] > 0 /\ bookEpoch[r] <= epoch)
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Coords = {c1, c2}
    Rooms = {r1, r2}
    MaxEpoch = 3
    None = None
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleBooking
CONSTRAINT TypeOK
